extraction.document_summary: AIA Protect 3 is a critical illness insurance plan designed to cover Singapore’s top 3 critical illnesses—Cancer, Heart Attack, and Stroke—with coverage split into early, intermediate, and major stages. The plan also adds a gender-specific benefit for major stage gender-specific cancers from the 3rd policy year. Buyers choose a coverage level of S$100K, S$200K, or S$300K and the coverage is stated to continue up to age 85. A key payout mechanic is a one-time claim-free cashback of 25% of the coverage amount paid on the policy anniversary on or after age 65, or 15 years from policy start, whichever is later. For major stage gender cancers, the brochure illustrates a base major stage critical illness benefit of S$300,000 plus an additional 15% (S$45,000) for a total of S$345,000. The brochure states “simple sign-ups, no medical checks” (via answering 4 questions) and that value-added medical services are not contractual benefits.
quality_notes: Payout mechanics are partially quantified: cashback (25%) and the gender-specific major stage cancer add-on (15%) are explicit; base CI stage payout amounts for early/intermediate are not stated.
Exclusions are mentioned only generically (e.g., pre-existing conditions), but specific excluded circumstances are not listed.

policies.quick_summary: Critical illness plan with early/intermediate/major stage coverage for Cancer, Heart Attack and Stroke, plus an extra 15% payout for major stage gender-specific cancers from the 3rd policy year. Offers claim-free 25% coverage cashback on/after age 65 or 15 years (whichever later) and coverage up to age 85 with options for S$100K/S$200K/S$300K coverage levels. Sign-up is stated as no medical checks (4 questions). Fixed premiums option available from age 70 (not guaranteed). Value-added services are not contractual benefits and may be withdrawn by partners/AIA at discretion where stated in the brochure.

important_caveats: Value-added services provided by partners are stated as not contractual benefits, independent third parties, and AIA reserves the right to cancel/terminate/withdraw the value-added services at its discretion.
Brochure states exclusions such as pre-existing conditions are specified in the policy contract (but specific exclusions are not listed in the brochure).
Waiting period and survival period are applicable before benefits will be payable (no durations stated).
Cashback is described as does not reduce the coverage amount upon payout (only payable once).
